title: Release visuals: model catalog release-note screenshots & deprecation artwork
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a set of polished visuals and annotated screenshots for the March catalog release notes: new model entries, deprecated models, pricing tier adjustments, and UI copy changes. Deliverables include desktop+mobile screenshots, light/dark theme variants, localized examples for DE/JP, an email release banner, and a compact deprecation illustration for the console release notes. Assets should be export-ready and uploaded to Drive with a Figma handoff. Coordinate with PM and Eng to ensure the screenshots match the final UI prior to cutover.
acceptance_criteria: Six primary screenshot variants delivered: desktop light/dark, mobile light/dark, DE localized desktop, JP localized desktop
All images exported at 1x/2x/3x and named according to imaging guidelines (see notes_for_engineering)
Figma file annotated with copy strings, component states, and accessibility notes
Design sign-off from Priya Shah (PM) and Carlos Mendes (Eng)
Assets uploaded to Drive + linked in the release notes PR before merge

design_decisions: Use compact pricing pill in release notes screenshots to reduce cognitive load; provide expanded table in console documentation instead.
Deprecation banner will use amber 400 background + 16px rounded corner pill to meet WCAG AA contrast at body sizes.
Localized screenshots will show translated model descriptions only — numeric and pricing formats will remain in USD with localized MMM separators to avoid regulatory complexities.
Chosen to omit experimental toggles from public screenshots to avoid customer confusion; add a small caption in release notes pointing to advanced docs.
Provide both light and dark modes to support product blog and social media usage.

Remove any dev-only toggles or overlay banners before final capture. Use the stable branch build confirmed by ENG-5581 on 2026-03-11.
Add links to final images in release notes PR body and in the Confluence page.
